storyEffectRecipe.motion: grayscale-to-color wipe, subtle pan, 0.4s scene wipe
storyEffectRecipe.alignmentRule: Use one persistent visual grammar and reserve blue for the currently active concept.

imageGeneration.outputMode: one distinct generation per scene; defect-only edits on scenes 4 and 5
imageGeneration.commonPromptRecipe: portrait 3:4 whiteboard editorial drawing, warm off-white paper, charcoal linework, cobalt-blue concept accent, generous subtitle-safe lower area, no logos or embedded prose

tts.credentialBoundary: API key is read from a private environment file at process runtime and is not stored in this repository.

research.guardrail: The video distinguishes evidence about reconstruction and suggestion from the stronger, unsupported claim that every retrieval changes memory or that all memory is unreliable.
